name: Minecraft (Vanilla)
author: raven
description: Pure vanilla Minecraft Java server from Mojang. No plugins, no mods — the original experience.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vanilla Installation Script

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server
fi

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
    VERSION="latest"
fi

if [ -z "${SERVER_JAR}" ]; then
    SERVER_JAR="server.jar"
fi

# Resolve "latest" to the newest release
if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    VERSION=$(curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r '.latest.release')
fi

# Find the version's manifest URL
URL=$(curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "${VERSION}" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url' | head -1)

if [ -z "${URL}" ] || [ "${URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Version ${VERSION} not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Get the server jar download URL and fetch it
JAR_URL=$(curl -s "${URL}" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')
curl -o ${SERVER_JAR} "${JAR_URL}"

# Accept the EULA so the server can start
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Vanilla ${VERSION} downloaded"

variables.name: Server Jar
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The version of Minecraft to install (e.g. 1.21.4, latest).
